stages.name: candidate_selection_and_source_boundary
stages.tool: select-production-candidate.py plus rendered PDF page review
checks: Atropa Belladonna spans exactly PDF pages 35-36, below the six-page limit.
PDF page 37 visibly begins Hyoscyamus niger.
The OCR score was treated only as triage; Taiwan-name and page-image gates made the final selection.

stages.name: name_and_source_exact_record
stages.tool: MOHW public naming source, declarative record contract and validate-plant-record.py
checks: Taiwan display name is 顛茄; Taiwan occurrence remains not_checked.
Seven record sections occur exactly on cited PDF pages 35-36.
Datura stramonium and 曼陀羅 are guarded as wrong-name conflations.
Plate-caption text is approved, but image reasoning remains disabled.

stages.name: embedding_and_retrieval
stages.tool: one gemini-embedding-2 Free Tier batch plus deterministic hybrid retrieval validators
checks: One external call embedded eight candidate chunks and six queries; incremental cost was zero.
Page baseline answer recall at rank 1 was 0.666667; section-aware 512/100 reached 1.0.
Traditional Chinese and English Atropin questions rank PDF page 36 first; distribution ranks PDF page 35 first.
Ambiguous Belladonna, Datura wrong-name and chromosome questions remain refused.

stages.name: portable_integration_and_regression
stages.tool: SQLite migration, chat API, Gem exporter and inactive n8n replay harness
checks: Main index contains 37 approved child chunks across 17 parent pages, two baselines and 21 approved queries.
The deterministic chat API passes 35 cases across five approved fact records.
The Classic Gem pack exports five records and 37 canonical child chunks.
PEHybridIdx001 matches canonical JSON, remains inactive, and n8n and Qwen are stopped.

warnings: The 512/100 profile is not claimed to beat page baselines for every taxon.
Historical medicinal content is not modern medical advice.
